purpose: Teach: 滞納/突発/陽性/観衆/空爆/同伴/中流/卓越

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、税の滞納問題を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura, you wrote your paper on tax delinquency issues, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, curious opening. Slight upward lilt on the question — genuine interest, not testing. Lean forward slightly. Patient pace.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、突発的な災害への備えを論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I actually wrote mine on disaster preparedness in the face of sudden catastrophes.
lines.style: Clear, direct answer. Light emphasis on the shift in topic. Not apologetic — matter-of-fact correction. Steady eye contact.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 感染症の陽性率の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ah, I see. So you explored infection positivity rates in your research?
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Soft acknowledgment of what she said. Gentle probe — testing the waters, not pushing. Warm curiosity.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、近代スポーツの観衆心理を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — my paper was actually on audience psychology in modern sports.
lines.style: Patient but clear. Slight firmness without edge. She's correcting the record again, gently. Not frustrated, just steady.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦時下の空爆被害史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Right, so wartime air-raid damage history — that was your focus?
lines.style: Engaged lean-in. Hands slightly open, receptive posture. She's actively tracking Sakura's actual work now. Respect in her voice.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、皇室の同伴行事を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I wrote about imperial family ceremonial events and public attendance patterns.
lines.style: Calm delivery. No frustration with the repeated pattern. She's learned Asuka is testing or distracted. Helpful clarification, warm undertone.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 中流階級の社会学を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Middle-class sociology, then — that was the subject of your thesis?
lines.style: Slower, more deliberate this time. Asuka catches herself — awareness crossing her face. Slightly apologetic lilt. Trying again.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、卓越したリーダーの研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Actually, no — my research focused on the qualities of exceptional leadership across historical contexts.
lines.style: Warm close with gentle firmness. A smile in her voice — not annoyed, but kindly done with the dance. Finality without coldness.
